The letters are on the right side: A is at row 2 column 4, B is at row 2 column 5, D is at row 4 column 5, E is at row 5 column 5, and C is at row 5 column 6. Reasoning: When folding the left half-page to the right half-page along the vertical line between column 3 and column 4, the columns will be mirrored left and right, while the rows remain unchanged; therefore column 3 maps to column 4, column 2 maps to column 5, and column 1 maps to column 6. Thus after the gray squares are folded over, they cover row 2 columns 4 and 5, row 3 column 4, row 4 columns 5 and 6, and row 5 column 6. A, B, D, and C are respectively at these covered positions, while E is at row 5 column 5, not at a covered position.

method.method_draft: First describe the image: it is a rectangular grid split by a thick vertical fold line between the third and fourth columns. The grey squares are all on the left side of the fold line, and the letters A, B, D, E, C are on the right side. Label the rows from top to bottom and columns from left to right. Read the grey squares as being at approximately row 2 columns 2 and 3, row 3 column 3, row 4 columns 1 and 2, and row 5 column 1. Read the letters as A at row 2 column 4, B at row 2 column 5, D at row 4 column 5, E at row 5 column 5, and C at row 5 column 6. Fold the left half over the right half across the vertical thick line, so columns mirror as 3→4, 2→5, and 1→6 while rows stay the same. The reflected grey squares cover row 2 columns 4 and 5, row 3 column 4, row 4 columns 5 and 6, and row 5 column 6. Thus A, B, D, and C are covered, but E at row 5 column 5 is not covered.
